meta.title: Initial setup
meta.description: Set up your account in a few steps.

title: Set up your account
subtitle: We will guide you through your first steps.

skip.title: Skip setup
skip.message: You can complete these steps later from Settings. Do you want to skip the walkthrough?

welcome.title: Welcome aboard!
welcome.intro: In less than a minute we will show you how to start organizing your finances.
welcome.languageHint: You can change it later from Settings.

account.title: Create your first account
account.subtitle: An account represents the money you hold in a bank, in cash or in savings.
account.balanceHint: Enter the balance you are starting with. It can be 0.
account.continueHint: Continue to discover your dashboard modules.
account.existingNote: You already have accounts. You can continue or create a new one.

salary.title: Set up your salary
salary.subtitle: With your salary and bonuses we project how your month and year will close.
salary.optionalNote: This step is optional: if you enter an amount, Continue saves it; if you leave it empty, Continue moves on without saving. You can also set it up later from Settings.
salary.successMessage: Your end-of-period projection is already live on the dashboard.
salary.continueHint: Use Continue to keep going through the walkthrough.

form.payDayOfMonthHint: Day of the month you receive your salary (1–31).
form.weekdayHint: Day of the week you receive your salary.
form.bonusesDescription: Add your bonuses so they are included in the projection.
form.bonusesEmpty: You have not added bonuses yet.

errors.amountRequired: Enter an amount greater than zero.
errors.amountWhole: The amount must be whole cents.
errors.amountMax: The amount exceeds the allowed maximum.
errors.nameRequired: Enter a name for the bonus.
errors.nameTooLong: The bonus name is too long.
errors.dayInvalid: The day must be between 1 and 31.
errors.payDayRange: The pay day must be between 1 and 31.
errors.weekdayRange: The weekday must be between Monday and Sunday.
errors.weeklyOneDay: For a weekly salary you must set exactly 1 weekday.
errors.biweeklyTwoDays: For a biweekly salary you must set exactly 2 days of the month (1-31).
errors.monthlyOneDay: For a monthly salary you must set exactly 1 day of the month (1-31).
errors.payDaysRequired: You must set at least one pay day.
errors.payDaysMax: No more than 2 pay days are allowed.
errors.maxBonuses: No more than {max} bonuses are allowed.
errors.saveFailed: The salary could not be saved.

modules.title: Explore the modules
modules.subtitle: These are the modules available in your panel. You can reach them from the sidebar.
modules.hint: There is nothing else to configure for now.

finish.title: All set!
finish.subtitle: Your account is configured. Here is a summary of what you did.

errors.sessionInvalid: Your session expired. Please sign in again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.nameRequired: Enter a name for the account.
errors.accountCreateFailed: The account could not be created.
errors.salarySaveFailed: The salary could not be saved.
errors.languageUpdateFailed: The language could not be updated.
